Title: Lexar NM790 with Heatsink 2TB PCIe Gen4 M.2 NVMe SSD Review
URL: https://www.thefpsreview.com/2024/04/17/lexar-nm790-with-heatsink-2tb-pcie-gen4-m-2-nvme-ssd-review/
Published: 2024-04-17T05:58:49.000Z
Author: Brent Justice
Highlights:
Lexar offers the NM790 SSD in two variations, one without a heatsink and one with an integrated pre-installed heatsink. We are specifically reviewing the NM790 with Heatsink M.2 2280 PCIe Gen 4×4 NVMe SSD part number LNM790X002T-RN9NU. Lexar offers the NM790 in three capacities, 1TB, 2TB, and 4TB, so it is great to see a 4TB model, meaning you can get high-speed performance and large capacity for a laptop or desktop or the PS5. 

| Lexar NM790 | |
| --- | --- |
| PCIe Generation | Gen4 x4 |
| Capacities Offered | 1TB, 2TB, 4TB |
| Versions | No Heatsink, With Heatsink |
| Cell Type | TLC |
| Controller | Maxio MAP1602 |
| NAND Flash | 232-Layer |
| DRAM Cache | DRAM-less, Host Memory Buffer 3.0 |
| SLC Caching | Yes |
| Read Speed | 7400MB/s |
| Write Speed | 6500MB/s |
| TBW | 1TB: 1000TBW, 2TB: 1500TBW, 4TB: 3000TBW |

...

What’s also great about all of these capacities is that all three offer the exact same read and write performance: Sequential read up to 7400MB/s, and sequential write up to 6500MB/s, so no matter which capacity you purchase, you are getting the same performance. The TBW isn’t bad either: 1TB is 1000TBW, 2TB is 1500TBW, and 4TB is 3000TBW, MTBF is 1,500,000 hours and Lexar offers a five-year limited warranty.

...

The Lexar NM790 is a standard 2280 M.2 heatsink, and Lexar has pre-installed the heatsink on this model, which covers both sides of the SSD. However, note that all the silicon is on one side only. Regardless, Lexar has designed this heatsink with thermal pads on both sides, which make contact with the all-aluminum heatsink to transfer heat on both sides.
